$comment: elements that predate the guard. A file may keep AT MOST its recorded count.
Drain a file to the `Table` primitive, then lower its ceiling in the same PR.
Not all of these are defects, and the guard cannot tell which. Three groups:
hand-roll the same overflow-x-auto + focus-ring + tab-stop pattern the
primitive owns; #1129 copied esign's into compliance on purpose. They are
correct today and should still be drained, because two implementations of
one rule is how the second one rots.
marketing/resource-mdx-components render on public pages that pay no 260px
rail; the primitive's semantic classes would fight the marketing theme.
UNDEFENDED, inside the shell. payment-portal (2), assessment-manager,
esign/templates-view, site-editor-v3/DomainPanel. Each has a scroller but
no tab stop, so an overflowing column is unreachable by keyboard
(WCAG 2.1.1). payment-portal is the one to drain first: 11
whitespace-nowrap cells on an owner-facing money screen.
